meta.producto: Small orange plastic components are being sorted and organized into linear rows.
meta.operacion: The right hand stabilizes or gathers parts from the central pile, while the left hand picks and places them into a structured row on the left.
meta.lugar: Supply area: large pile of orange parts in the center. Work point: center-left of the table where parts are aligned into rows. Other parts are located on the far left and right.
meta.convencion_texto: holding the workpiece while the other hand is only transporting (not operating) is also D (course convention);
meta.camara: Operator is at the bottom of the image. The left hand (Cyan) appears on the left/center, and the right hand (Magenta) appears in the center.
meta.title_en: Plastic parts assembly at a factory station (factory video, CC BY 4.0)
meta.motor_en: Gemma 4 31B (4-bit QAT) on a cloud NVIDIA A100 with vLLM; vision model only, no human review (development run)
meta.licencia_en: Video: Factory Manipulation Videos by Procedural Robotics Inc. (huggingface.co/datasets/procedural-robotics/factory-manipulation-videos), CC BY 4.0. Excerpt 60-210 s of plastic_assembly_station05_worker032.mp4, re-encoded; chart computed by Gilbreth.
